headerDisplay: HomeKit control of eufy Permanent Outdoor Lights (E22 / T8L02) over eufy's cloud. Works from anywhere — no Bluetooth range needed. Auto-discovers the smart lights on your account.
footerDisplay: Uses @mega-yfue/eufy-sdk. Your login is used only to reach your own devices; the session token is cached at sessionPath. If your account uses 2FA, run `npm run cloud-login` once (see README) to establish the session.

countryCode.title: Country code
countryCode.description: Two-letter country of your eufy account (region auto-discovers from it).

sessionPath.title: Session file path (advanced)
sessionPath.description: Where to cache the login session. Defaults to <homebridge storage>/eufy-permanent-lights-session.json.
